name: Board of Library Trustees - Dark Meeting - Jul 08, 2026
agenda_text:
BURBANK BOARD OF LIBRARY TRUSTEES
  NOTICE OF DARK MEETING

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that there will be no Burbank Board of Library
Trustees meeting on July 8, 2026. The next regular meeting will take place
on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, in the Central Library Auditorium at 110 N.
Glenoaks Boulevard, Burbank, CA 91502.

  Posted by: M. Lund
  Posted Date: July 2, 2026
